graders.name: b1-sql-injection
graders.evidence:
I reviewed the diff myself instead of running the plugin's three reviewer subagents. The diff is small and the defects can be confirmed directly from the code. I didn't run the tests because I have no shell in this session, so the test failures named below come from reading the code, not from running it.

```json
[
  {
    "file": "src/models/book.ts",
    "line": 52,
    "severity": "critical",
    "issue": "SQL injection: the author LIKE pattern is pasted into the SQL string instead of being bound as a parameter. This breaks AC4 ('SQL is parameterised: no string-built queries').",
    "evidence": "`SELECT * FROM books WHERE title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR author LIKE '${pattern}' ESCAPE '\\\\' ORDER BY title`, [pattern]. Only % _ and \\ are escaped, not the single quote. q = \"' OR 1=1 --\" builds `author LIKE '%' OR 1=1 --%' ...`, which returns every row. The AC4 tests that expect [] for this input would fail."
  },
  {
    "file": "src/views/books/search-results.ejs",
    "line": 2,
    "severity": "critical",
    "issue": "Reflected XSS: the user's query is printed into the no-results message without HTML escaping.",
    "evidence": "`No books found matching \"<%- query %>\"`: `<%-` outputs raw HTML. GET /books/search?q=<script>alert(1)</script> matches no book, so the script tag is sent back as live HTML. It should be `<%= query %>`. The html test 'the no-results message HTML-escapes the query' would fail."
  },
  {
    "file": "src/routes/api.ts",
    "line": 41,
    "severity": "major",
    "issue": "GET /api/books/search never reaches the search handler. It is registered after /books/:id, so the :id route catches it and returns 404.",
    "evidence": "router.get('/books/:id', ...) is at line 30 and router.get('/books/search', searchHandler) at line 41. For /api/books/search, parseInt('search') is NaN, getBookById(NaN) returns undefined, and the response is 404 {error:'Book not found'}. The search route must be registered before the :id route."
  },
  {
    "file": "src/models/book.ts",
    "line": 37,
    "severity": "major",
    "issue": "Off-by-one in the length limit: a query of exactly 100 characters is rejected. The ticket only rejects queries over 100.",
    "evidence": "`if (trimmed.length >= MAX_SEARCH_QUERY_LENGTH)` throws at length 100, which contradicts both the ticket ('over 100 characters returns a validation error') and the code's own message ('100 characters or fewer'). It should be `>`. The 'exactly 100 characters is allowed' tests would fail."
  },
  {
    "file": "src/routes/books.ts",
    "line": 15,
    "severity": "major",
    "issue": "The HTML search route returns no results for an empty or blank query. The ticket says an empty query returns all books (AC2).",
    "evidence": "`const books = query ? Book.searchBooks(query) : [];`: a missing, empty or whitespace-only q renders zero cards, but searchBooks('') would already return getAllBooks(). The html AC2 tests that expect 50 cards would fail."
  },
  {
    "file": "tests/search/book-search.model.test.ts",
    "line": 60,
    "severity": "minor",
    "issue": "Weak test: the case-insensitive author test checks nothing about the results, so AC1 isn't really covered for authors at the model level (AC5).",
    "evidence": "for (const q of ['FRANK HERBERT', 'frank herbert', 'fRaNk HeRbErT']) { expect(Array.isArray(Book.searchBooks(q))).toBe(true); }: this passes even if nothing matches. It should assert titles(...) equals ['Dune'], like the title case-insensitivity test does."
  }
]
```

| Severity | Location | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| critical | src/models/book.ts:52 | Author LIKE pattern pasted into the SQL string (SQL injection, breaks AC4) |
| critical | src/views/books/search-results.ejs:2 | `<%- query %>` prints the query unescaped (reflected XSS) |
| major | src/routes/api.ts:41 | `/books/search` registered after `/books/:id`, so it returns 404 |
| major | src/models/book.ts:37 | `>=` rejects a query of exactly 100 characters |
| major | src/routes/books.ts:15 | HTML route returns `[]` for an empty query instead of all books |
| minor | tests/search/book-search.model.test.ts:60 | Author case-insensitivity test only checks that the result is an array |

graders.evidence:
I found 6 defects. I only read `TICKET.md` and `CHANGES.diff` and didn't run the tests. Line numbers point into the files after the change, worked out from the diff's line-range headers.

Several of these defects would also make the PR's own tests fail, so `npm run test:run` should not pass. That breaks the ticket's last acceptance criterion.

  {
    "file": "src/models/book.ts",
    "line": 55,
    "severity": "critical",
    "issue": "SQL injection: the author LIKE pattern is pasted straight into the SQL text instead of being passed as a parameter. This breaks AC4 ('SQL is parameterised: no string-built queries'). The escaping only handles \\, % and _, not single quotes.",
    "evidence": "`SELECT * FROM books WHERE title LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR author LIKE '${pattern}' ESCAPE '\\\\' ORDER BY title`, [pattern] — only one ? placeholder is used.   },
  {
    "file": "src/models/book.ts",
    "line": 37,
    "severity": "high",
    "issue": "Off-by-one in the length check: a query of exactly 100 characters is rejected. AC3 only rejects queries over 100.",
    "evidence": "`if (trimmed.length >= MAX_SEARCH_QUERY_LENGTH)` should be `>`. The error text itself says '100 characters or fewer', and the PR's tests 'exactly 100 characters is allowed' (model, API and HTML) would fail."
  },
  {
    "file": "src/routes/api.ts",
    "line": 40,
    "severity": "high",

    "line": 25,
    "severity": "high",
    "issue": "In the HTML search route, an empty or whitespace-only query returns no books instead of all books. This breaks AC2.",

  },
  {
    "file": "src/views/books/search-results.ejs",
    "line": 2,
    "severity": "high",
    "issue": "Reflected XSS: the user's query is printed unescaped in the no-results message.",
    "evidence": "`No books found matching \"<%- query %>\".` — `<%-` prints raw HTML. It should be `<%=`. For q=<script>alert(1)</script> the script runs, and the PR's tests 'the no-results message HTML-escapes the query' fail."
  },

    "file": "tests/search/book-search.model.test.ts",
    "line": 62,
    "severity": "low",

  }
